POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
POLICY.DATA_BODY: Your email address, username and avatar, the hash of your password, your encrypted two-factor secret, your friendships, your messages, your matches and your ranking.
POLICY.PURPOSE_BODY: Only to run the game: logging you in, letting you play, chat and follow your progress. Your data is never sold and never used for advertising.
POLICY.RETENTION_BODY: As long as your account exists. When you delete your account, your data is erased immediately and irreversibly.
POLICY.RIGHTS_BODY: You can download all your data as a JSON file and delete your account from the "My data" page. You can correct your information from your profile.
POLICY.CONTACT_BODY: For any question about your data, write to onitama.transcendance@gmail.com.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of Use
TERMS.SERVICE_BODY: Onitama is an online board game offered free of charge as part of a student project. It is provided as is, with no guarantee of availability.
TERMS.ACCOUNT_BODY: You are responsible for your account and for keeping your credentials confidential. The information you provide must be accurate.
TERMS.CONDUCT_BODY: Play fairly and respect other players. Cheating, harassment and abusive messages are forbidden.
TERMS.TERMINATION_BODY: You can delete your account at any time from the "My data" page. We may suspend an account that does not respect these terms.
TERMS.LIABILITY_BODY: We cannot be held liable for service interruptions or for the loss of game data.
